title: WaterColor 1785 E. County Hwy 30A #301
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 4 amenity access bands.**- Gulf views from living room, dining room and patio- Located in the Park District of WaterColor- Access to community pools, nature trails, and dune lakes- Newly Renovated Bathrooms and New Flooring 2024- Smart TVs- Washer/Dryer- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout. Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Enjoy Gulf views from the "Point of Vue" patio while breathing in the fresh salt air from your vantage point in WaterColor's popular Park District. This adorable 1-bedroom with loft, 2 bathroom unit sleeps 4 and is close to the beach, the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club, and Seaside. "Point of Vue" has newly remodeled bathrooms, new flooring, and a cottage coastal decor. The primary bedroom with a Smart TV, king bed and newly renovated private bathroom with walk in shower is tucked beside the kitchen - perfect for late-night snacks. The dining table flows into the living room boasting comfortable sofas, and oversized chairs surrounding a large Smart TV. This comfortable space provides family an area to share stories from the beach. Up a wooden staircase, perched high above the living room, is a cozy loft space with a full bed and sitting chair. Explore 30A and WaterColor's nature trails with the 2 provided adult bikes. Then, indulge your senses at WaterColor's Beach Club. It now features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar called Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. So don't miss your chance! Book "Point of Vue" today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:- Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk in Shower- Loft: Full Bed with Shared 1st Floor Bathroom with ShowerWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS: - Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Pickle ball courts- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preservesPlease note: Effective January 11th 2024, Watercolor Community HOA will no longer allow Low-Speed Vehicles to be rented by guests staying in the Town Center Condos.
